annotations.description: Given three control plane nodes, the overall CPU utilization may only be about 2/3 of all available capacity. This is because if a single control plane node fails, the remaining two must handle the load of the cluster in order to be HA. If the cluster is using more than 2/3 of all capacity, if one control plane node fails, the remaining two are likely to fail when they take the load. To fix this, increase the CPU and memory on your control plane nodes.
annotations.summary: CPU utilization across all three control plane nodes is higher than two control plane nodes can sustain; a single control plane node outage may cause a cascading failure; increase available CPU.
